payload.title: Godot requirements intake identifies malformed CLI and proposal responses and safely resumes the original request

# Diagnose malformed model responses in the Godot requirements entry

<!-- gonggong-request:editor-requirements-json-diagnostics-20261113 -->

Parent: #773; original production continuation: #951. The user authorized continuous completion of Godot editor production support. The current host owns this isolated change and the original acceptance session; other installations, credentials and worker occupancy remain unchanged.

After verified PR #1066 installation, the original operator successfully reconfirmed the unchanged Issue4 design through the native dialog. Original workers, candidates, terminals, reviews and registrations stayed unchanged. A subsequent status-only request failed with `Extra data: line 3 column 1 (char 286)`. One normal explicit retry preserved the original request digest and failed with `Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)`. Both attempts stopped at `model_attempted`, before proposal publication. Raw CLI/model output had already been cleaned up, so the failing parse layer cannot be established from those messages. The original native production status tool did not run.

Scope: the existing installed requirements adapter, its CLI/no-tools response contract and focused tests. Make malformed output diagnosable without exposing source text, prompts, credentials or personal paths. Distinguish the CLI response envelope from the requirement proposal. Keep strict single-document JSON, required types, no-tools rules, real Issue binding, cancellation and explicit retry. Do not accept the first object from concatenated JSON, infer a proposal from prose, bypass intake or automatically repeat unknown remote actions. Use actual diagnosed evidence to correct any response-contract defect found within this scope.

Acceptance:

- Malformed outer JSON, malformed or empty inner proposal, invalid envelope shape and prohibited tool actions return specific bounded failure stages. Diagnostics contain only necessary structural metadata, positions, lengths and digests, never response content or credentials. Existing valid responses and proposal validation still work.
- Failed model attempts retain their original request identity and auditable failure stage. No Issue creation, comment publication or production dispatch occurs before a valid proposal. Normal explicit retry archives the failed attempt and preserves the original request; cancellation and pending-publication reconciliation remain intact.
- Focused transport/adapter tests cover valid and invalid responses, no-tools boundaries and original-request retry. A real installed original-session retry reports either a valid continuation and actual status result or an accurately localized failure; successful game business acceptance remains separately required by #951.
- Independent review, formal gates, exact-candidate CI/main and installed-host verification complete the delivery. Preserve the original two failures and unknown raw output. Do not close #773 or claim the full production task complete from diagnostics alone.

This modifies existing host-tool Python/JavaScript only if required by the demonstrated defect; it adds no module or authority. Repository paths resolve from the checkout root. Validation output stays in the owning host's private receipt directory. If a compatible host-tool-only update is supported, verify update and rollback on the same admitted binary; otherwise follow the existing full build/install contract. Restore the previous verified host files to roll back, preserving all request journals and production evidence. No external engine directory is changed.


执行授权来源（由调用宿主核实，不代替候选准入）：https://github.com/zhzyx/nightmarish-spooky-sorceryze/issues/773
